
=== Transaction: DB.Troquel ===

--- Start (Event) ---
[web]
    {
	gestionartroquel.Call(&Mode, &TroquelId)
	}
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	
    [web]
    {
	TroquelId.Visible = False
	}
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		TroquelWW.Call()
	Endif
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&TroquelId);

TroquelId = &TroquelId if not &TroquelId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(TroquelId);
noprompt(TroquelId);

}

LoadAuditTroquel.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, TroquelId, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditTroquel.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, TroquelId, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditTroquel.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, TroquelId, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditTroquel.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, TroquelId, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: Produccion.gestionarTroquel ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&ProductoCategoriaNombre = obtenerconfiguracion.Udp(!'CategoriaCarrete')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'troquel_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Update AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'troquel_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'troquel_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&Troquel.Load(&TroquelId)
			&LoadSuccess = &Troquel.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &Troquel.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				Troquel_TroquelNombre.Enabled = False
				Troquel_TroquelEstado.Enabled = False
				Troquel_TroquelActivo.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	Combo_Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.TitleControlIdToReplace = Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.InternalName
	Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.HorizontalAlignment = !'Left'
	Do 'LoadComboTroquel_Producto__ProductoId'
	Troquel_TroquelId.Visible = False
	GridLevel_Producto_Empowerer.GridInternalName = GridLevel_Producto.InternalName
	GridLevel_Producto.Rows = 0
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_Producto.ColumnHeaderClass = !'WWIconActionColumn'
	Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.ColumnHeaderClass = !'WWColumn'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridLevel_Producto.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the grid
	&LineDeleted = (&TroquelProductoDeleted.IndexOf(&Troquel.Producto.IndexOf(&Troquel.Producto.CurrentItem)) > 0)
	Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.Enabled = (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Update) AND (not &LineDeleted) AND &Troquel.Producto.CurrentItem.ToXml().Contains(!'<Mode>INS</Mode>')
	&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_Producto = !'<i class="fa fa-times TrnGridDelete"></i>'
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Update)
		&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_Producto.Class = !'Attribute'
	Else
		&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_Producto.Class = !'Invisible'
	Endif
	&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_Producto.ColumnClass = iif(&LineDeleted, !'WWIconActionColumn WWColumnLineThrough WWColumnLineThroughFirstColumn', !'WWIconActionColumn')
	Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.ColumnClass = iif(&LineDeleted, !'WWColumn WWColumnLineThrough', !'WWColumn')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoAddGridLineGridLevel_Producto' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&TroquelProductoItem = new()
	&Troquel.Producto.Add(&TroquelProductoItem)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&Troquel.Delete()
			Else
				&TroquelProductoDeleted.Sort()
				Do While &TroquelProductoDeleted.Count > 0
					&Troquel.Producto.Remove(&TroquelProductoDeleted.Item(&TroquelProductoDeleted.Count))
					&TroquelProductoDeleted.Remove(&TroquelProductoDeleted.Count)
				EndDo
				&Troquel.Save()
			EndIf
			If &Troquel.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &Troquel.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &DeleteGridLineGridLevel_Producto.Click (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Index = &Troquel.Producto.IndexOf(&Troquel.Producto.CurrentItem)
	If &TroquelProductoDeleted.IndexOf(&Index) > 0
		&TroquelProductoDeleted.Remove(&TroquelProductoDeleted.IndexOf(&Index))
	Else
		&TroquelProductoDeleted.Add(&Index)
	EndIf
	GridLevel_Producto.Refresh()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Combo_Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
&ProductoCategoriaId.FromString(Combo_Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.SelectedValue_get)

--- Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.ControlValueChanged (Event) ---
Combo_Troquel_Producto__ProductoId.SelectedValue_set = iif(&ProductoCategoriaId.IsEmpty(), '', &ProductoCategoriaId.ToString().Trim())
	&Troquel.Producto.CurrentItem.ProductoId = &ProductoCategoriaId

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(in:&TrnMode, in:&TroquelId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: DB.LoadAuditTroquel ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each DB.Troquel
		Where TroquelId = &TroquelId
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Troquel'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = TroquelId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new SAE.DB.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelNombre'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Nombre'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = TroquelNombre.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelEnPrensa'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'En Prensa'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = TroquelEnPrensa.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelEstado'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Estado'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = TroquelEstado.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelActivo'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Activo'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = TroquelActivo.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		For Each Troquel.Producto
			
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'TroquelProducto'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new DB.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Compatible'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ProductoId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoNombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Nombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ProductoNombre.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoClave'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Clave'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ProductoClave.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoDescripcion'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Descripcion'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ProductoDescripcion.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Nombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ProductoCategoriaNombre.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndFor
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Troquel
		Where TroquelId = &TroquelId
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Troquel'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelNombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Nombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DB.TroquelNombre.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelEnPrensa'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'En Prensa'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelEnPrensa.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new SAE.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelEstado'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Estado'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelEstado.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelActivo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Activo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelActivo.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			For Each Troquel.Producto
				
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'TroquelProducto'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = GeneXus.TrnMode.Insert
				&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)
				
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoId'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Compatible'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoId.ToString()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new DB.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoNombre'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Nombre'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoNombre.ToString()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoClave'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Clave'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoClave.ToString()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoDescripcion'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Descripcion'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoDescripcion.ToString()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Nombre'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoCategoriaNombre.ToString()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			EndFor
		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			&CountUpdatedProductoId = 0
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
				Do Case
					Case &AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Troquel'
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelNombre'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelNombre.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelEnPrensa'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelEnPrensa.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelEstado'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelEstado.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'TroquelActivo'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = TroquelActivo.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
				Case &AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'TroquelProducto'
					
					&CountKeyAttributes = 0
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoId'
								&KeyProductoId.FromString(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue)											
								&CountKeyAttributes += 1
								If &CountKeyAttributes = 1
									Exit
								EndIf
						EndCase
					EndFor

					For Each DB.Troquel.Producto
						Where ProductoId = &KeyProductoId

						&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = TrnMode.Update
						&CountUpdatedProductoId += 1

						For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
							Do Case
								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoId'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoId.ToString()

								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoNombre'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DB.ProductoNombre.ToString()

								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoClave'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoClave.ToString()

								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoDescripcion'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoDescripcion.ToString()

								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductoCategoriaNombre.ToString()

							EndCase
						EndFor
					When None
						&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = TrnMode.Delete
					EndFor

				EndCase
			EndFor
			If &CountUpdatedProductoId < Count(ProductoId, TroquelId = &TroquelId)

				&AuditingObjectNewRecords = New()

				For Each DB.Troquel.Producto
					Where TroquelId = &TroquelId
					&KeyProductoId = ProductoId
					&RecordExistsProductoId = False

					For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
						If &AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'TroquelProducto'
							&CountKeyAttributes = 0
							For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
								Do Case
									Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductoId'
										If &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue.Trim() = &KeyProductoId.ToString().Trim()
											&RecordExistsProductoId = True
											&CountKeyAttributes += 1
											If &CountKeyAttributes = 1
												Exit
											EndIf
										EndIf
								EndCase
							EndFor
						EndIf
					EndFor

					If Not (&RecordExistsProductoId)
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.TableName = !'TroquelProducto'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Mode = TrnMode.Insert
						&AuditingObjectNewRecords.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoId'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Producto Compatible'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = True
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = ProductoId.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoNombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Producto Nombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = ProductoNombre.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoClave'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Producto Clave'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = ProductoClave.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoDescripcion'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Producto Descripcion'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = ProductoDescripcion.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'ProductoCategoriaNombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Nombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = ProductoCategoriaNombre.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

					EndIf
				EndFor
				For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObjectNewRecords.Record
					&AuditingObject.Record.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItem)
				EndFor
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&SaveOldValues, inout:&AuditingObject, in: &TroquelId, in:&ActualMode);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== WebPanel: DB.TroquelWW ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&IsAuthorized_TroquelNombre = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'troquelview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Troquel'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.TroquelWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.TroquelWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	TroquelId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	TroquelNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	TroquelEnPrensa.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	TroquelEstado.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	TroquelActivo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TroquelId'
					&TFTroquelId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFTroquelId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TroquelNombre'
					&TFTroquelNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFTroquelNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TroquelEnPrensa'
					&TFTroquelEnPrensa = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TroquelEstado'
					&TFTroquelEstado_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFTroquelEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFTroquelEstado_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TroquelActivo'
					&TFTroquelActivo_Sel.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = DB.Troquel.Link(TrnMode.Update, TroquelId)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = DB.Troquel.Link(TrnMode.Delete, TroquelId)
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_TroquelNombre)
		TroquelNombre.Link = DB.TroquelView.Link(TroquelId, '')
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'DB.TroquelWWColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.TroquelWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.TroquelWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.TroquelWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.Troquel.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(TroquelId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDC_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'Troquel', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord, '', '')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

DVB_SDTComboData
Where ProductoCategoriaId = &ProductoCategoriaId when Not &ProductoCategoriaId.IsEmpty()

	{
		ID = Notifications.ProductoId.ToString()
		Title = ProductoClave
	}
}

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(&ProductoCategoriaId, &ProductoCategoriaNombre);


=== Procedure: Produccion.ObtenerConfiguracion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
FOR EACH DB.Configuracion
	WHERE ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
	&ConfiguracionValor = ConfiguracionValor
	EXIT
WHEN NONE
	new 
		ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
		ConfiguracionValor = ''
	endnew
	commit
ENDFOR

--- Rules (Rules) ---
PARM(IN:&ConfiguracionKey, OUT:&ConfiguracionValor);


=== DataProvider: Produccion.TipoCarreteDP ===

--- Source (Source) ---
SDTProducto
{
	SDTProductoItem
	where ProductoCategoriaNombre = ObtenerConfiguracion.Udp(!'CategoriaCarrete')
	{
		ProductoId = ProductoId
		ProductoClave = ProductoClave
		ProductoNombre = ProductoNombre
		ProductoDescripcion = ProductoDescripcion
		ProductoCategoriaId = ProductoCategoriaId
		ProductoCategoriaNombre = ProductoCategoriaNombre
		ProductoPrecioUnitario = ProductoPrecioUnitario
		ProductoInventarioActual = ProductoInventarioActual
		ProductoActivo = ProductoActivo
		ProductoClaveExterna = ProductoClaveExterna
		ProductoImagen = ProductoImagen
	}
}

=== Procedure: DB.TroquelWWExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"TroquelWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTroquelId.IsEmpty() AND &TFTroquelId_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFTroquelId
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFTroquelId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTroquelNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Nombre")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFTroquelNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFTroquelNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Nombre")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFTroquelNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "En Prensa")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFTroquelEnPrensa.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "En Prensa")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFTroquelEnPrensa)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTroquelEstado_Sels.Count = 0)
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Estado")
		&i = 1
		For &TFTroquelEstado_Sel in &TFTroquelEstado_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = ''
			Else
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += ', '
			EndIf
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text += &TFTroquelEstado_Sel.EnumerationDescription()
			&i += 1
		EndFor
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTroquelActivo_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Activo")
		Do Case
			Case &TFTroquelActivo_Sel = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSChecked"
			Case &TFTroquelActivo_Sel = 2
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "WWP_TSUnChecked"
		EndCase
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.TroquelWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.TroquelWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each Troquel
		order TroquelNombre  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TroquelNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TroquelId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TroquelId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TroquelEstado  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TroquelEstado)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TroquelActivo  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TroquelActivo)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using TroquelWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFTroquelId, &TFTroquelId_To, &TFTroquelNombre, &TFTroquelNombre_Sel, &TFTroquelEnPrensa
					, &TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel, &TFTroquelEstado_Sels, &TFTroquelActivo_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'TroquelId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = TroquelId
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'TroquelNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(TroquelNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'TroquelEnPrensa'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(TroquelEnPrensa)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'TroquelEstado'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = TroquelEstado.EnumerationDescription()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'TroquelActivo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = TroquelActivo.ToString()
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"TroquelId", '', !'Id', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"TroquelNombre", '', !'Nombre', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"TroquelEnPrensa", '', !'En Prensa', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"TroquelEstado", '', !'Estado', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"TroquelActivo", '', !'Activo', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'DB.TroquelWWColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.TroquelWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.TroquelWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.TroquelWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELID"
				&TFTroquelId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFTroquelId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELNOMBRE"
				&TFTroquelNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELNOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFTroquelNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELENPRENSA"
				&TFTroquelEnPrensa.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELENPRENSA_SEL"
				&TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELESTADO_SEL"
				&TFTroquelEstado_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFTroquelEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFTroquelEstado_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFTroquelActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== Procedure: DB.TroquelWWExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'troquelww_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Troquel List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not (&TFTroquelId.IsEmpty() AND &TFTroquelId_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFTroquelId
		&TFTroquelId_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Id", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFTroquelId_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFTroquelNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFTroquelNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFTroquelNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFTroquelNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFTroquelEnPrensa.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFTroquelEnPrensa
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&TFTroquelEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFTroquelEstado_SelsJson)
	If not &TFTroquelEstado_Sels.Count = 0
		&i = 1
		For &TFTroquelEstado_Sel in &TFTroquelEstado_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&TFTroquelEstado_SelDscs = ''
			Else
				&TFTroquelEstado_SelDscs += ', '
			EndIf
			&FilterTFTroquelEstado_SelValueDescription = &TFTroquelEstado_Sel.EnumerationDescription()

			&TFTroquelEstado_SelDscs += &FilterTFTroquelEstado_SelValueDescription
			&i += 1
		EndFor
		print printBlockTFTroquelEstado_Sel
	EndIf
	If not &TFTroquelActivo_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Do Case
			Case &TFTroquelActivo_Sel = 1
				&FilterTFTroquelActivo_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSChecked" 
			Case &TFTroquelActivo_Sel = 2
				&FilterTFTroquelActivo_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSUnChecked" 
		EndCase

		print printBlockTFTroquelActivo_Sel
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each Troquel
		order TroquelNombre  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TroquelNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TroquelId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TroquelId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TroquelEstado  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TroquelEstado)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order TroquelActivo  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (TroquelActivo)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using TroquelWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFTroquelId, &TFTroquelId_To, &TFTroquelNombre, &TFTroquelNombre_Sel, &TFTroquelEnPrensa
					, &TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel, &TFTroquelEstado_Sels, &TFTroquelActivo_Sel)
		&TroquelEstadoDescription = TroquelEstado.EnumerationDescription()

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.TroquelWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.TroquelWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.TroquelWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELID"
				&TFTroquelId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFTroquelId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELNOMBRE"
				&TFTroquelNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELNOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFTroquelNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELENPRENSA"
				&TFTroquelEnPrensa.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELENPRENSA_SEL"
				&TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELESTADO_SEL"
				&TFTroquelEstado_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFTroquelEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFTroquelEstado_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFTroquelActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: DB.TroquelWWGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_TROQUELNOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadTroquelNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_TROQUELENPRENSA'
		Do 'LoadTroquelEnPrensaOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.TroquelWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.TroquelWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.TroquelWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELID"
				&TFTroquelId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFTroquelId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELNOMBRE"
				&TFTroquelNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELNOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFTroquelNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELENPRENSA"
				&TFTroquelEnPrensa.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELENPRENSA_SEL"
				&TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELESTADO_SEL"
				&TFTroquelEstado_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFTroquelEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFTroquelEstado_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFTROQUELACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFTroquelActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadTroquelNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFTroquelNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFTroquelNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each Troquel
		Order TroquelNombre
		using DB.TroquelWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFTroquelId, &TFTroquelId_To, &TFTroquelNombre, &TFTroquelNombre_Sel, &TFTroquelEnPrensa
					, &TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel, &TFTroquelEstado_Sels, &TFTroquelActivo_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each Troquel
			Order TroquelNombre
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not TroquelNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = TroquelNombre
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadTroquelEnPrensaOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFTroquelEnPrensa = &SearchTxt
	&TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each Troquel
		using TroquelWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFTroquelId, &TFTroquelId_To, &TFTroquelNombre, &TFTroquelNombre_Sel, &TFTroquelEnPrensa
					, &TFTroquelEnPrensa_Sel, &TFTroquelEstado_Sels, &TFTroquelActivo_Sel)

		If not TroquelEnPrensa.IsEmpty()
			&Option = TroquelEnPrensa
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			If &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) = &Option
				&count.FromString(&OptionIndexes.Item(&InsertIndex))
				&count += 1
				&OptionIndexes.Remove(&InsertIndex)
				&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
			Else
				&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
				&OptionIndexes.Add(!'1', &InsertIndex)
			EndIf
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&DDOName, in:&SearchTxt, in:&SearchTxtTo, out:&OptionsJson, out:&OptionsDescJson, out:&OptionIndexesJson);

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== WebPanel: DB.ViewConfiguracion ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	For each
		Where ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
		Form.Caption = ConfiguracionKey.ToString()
		ViewAll.Link = WWConfiguracion.Link()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "Record not found"
		ViewAll.Visible = false
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	If &Exists
		&SelectedTabCode = &TabCode
		Tab.ActivePageControlName = &SelectedTabCode
		Do 'Load Tab'
	Endif

--- Tab.TabChanged (Event) ---
&SelectedTabCode = Tab.ActivePageControlName
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	Do 'Load Tab'

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ConfiguracionKey, in:&TabCode);


=== WebPanel: DB.WWConfiguracion ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	Grid.Rows = 10
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	Form.Caption = 'Configuracions'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Grid.LoadSessionState()

--- Refresh (Event) ---
Grid.SaveSessionState()

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&Update.Link = Configuracion.Link(TrnMode.Update, ConfiguracionKey)
	&Delete.Link = Configuracion.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ConfiguracionKey)
	ConfiguracionKey.Link = ViewConfiguracion.Link(ConfiguracionKey, "")

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
Configuracion(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ConfiguracionKey))
